scope: Scalar Brownian first passage, two affine segments, and independent Erlang renewal; finite fixed fixtures do not prove uniform continuous convergence.

second_segment.reference: Integrate the second-segment Brownian maximum density against the closed killed-endpoint CDF; neither tested first_hit nor two_segment_first_hit is called by this reference.

renewal.reference: Integrate the inverse-Gaussian density in log time against an Erlang recovery CDF; independent of the tested normal-coordinate mapping and analytic gradient.

preserve: Existing low-noise CTMC grids remain unqualified; repairing an integral does not remove artificial diffusion.
Count-tail bounds do not certify gradient tails or floating-point roundoff.
Keep the before-repair evidence and all earlier resolution failures.
